bio_draft: Baalti is a DJ and production duo of Mihir Chauhan and Jaiveer Singh, both born in India, who started in the San Francisco Bay Area in 2020 and are now based in New York. Their music blends UK bass and club styles with the soundsystem traditions of West Bengal and Delhi, with releases on Krunk Kulture, All My Thoughts and Steel City Dance Discs. They host a monthly show on Rinse FM.

bio_sources.fact: duo, members, born in India, started in Bay Area 2020, now New York
UK bass with West Bengal and Delhi traditions

notes: Strong identity. City: older sources (Wild City 2021, Forced Exposure 2023, Refuge) say San Francisco; RA (2025), Bandcamp and DJ Mag (2026) say New York/Brooklyn, so use New York. Mela release date: DJ Mag says out 20 February (year implied 2025); RA review dated 2025-02-20, so date left null. Better Together label is All My Thoughts (Seb Wildblood), cat AMT 032EP. Mixcloud oEmbed returned nothing from the shell, so the Mixmag Asia Mixcloud URL is taken from the embed feed on the Mixmag Asia page. Rinse and Refuge links are outlet pages, not SoundCloud/YouTube. A FADER mix with Lapgan (June 2026) exists but was not opened. Web search budget ran out before checking Discogs/Beatport ids.

bio_draft: EBITDA is an Indian DJ, rooted in Kolkata, who played clubs in Delhi and Bangalore before moving to the UK, where he is resident at Simple in Oxford. His sets cover electro, breaks, IDM, techno, drum and bass and acid, and he has closed for Joy Orbison.

bio_sources.fact: Simple Oxford residency, closed for Joy Orbison

notes: No original releases found. Wild City lists him as Kolkata-rooted; Ticket Fairy says he started DJing in Delhi then Bangalore. Current base likely Oxford/UK (RA). Also has a Subtle Radio show 'Bangers Galore' and GroFM residency. YouTube titles confirmed by oEmbed (MISSION LONDON and Bangkok Community Radio channels).

bio_draft: Works Of Intent is the UK techno producer Roshan Chauhan, who released as R.O.S.H. on Rekids, Turbo and Monkeytown before changing his name in 2021. His debut album Richer Sound (2023) reworks big room techno with UK breaks, and he is project manager for the South Asian collective DAYTIMERS.

bio_sources.fact: Richer Sound 2023, big room techno, UK

notes: Base city not stated on any page opened (ADE tags GB; DAYTIMERS runs nights in London). Richer Sound includes six tracks first released on COD3 QR (Laurent Garnier and Scan X); label of the album itself not stated on Bandcamp. Years for Creek, Body Remembers, Mother's Genes, Measure Of A Man, And More are from the Bandcamp discography list (month and year shown). Earlier R.O.S.H. releases on Rekids/Turbo/Monkeytown not itemised. Prima Lux link is a When We Dip podcast page.

Could not tie the NDCR guest (Ambient, Breaks, IDM, 11 Dec 2025) to a page. Candidates seen: Anisha, a Bombay DJ on Magnetic Fields 2023 (instagram anishaaparwani; disco, breaks, club) at https://2023.magneticfields.in/artists/anisha, which only partly matches the genres; Anisha AOD is a Delhi folk-pop singer, not a match. Web search budget ran out before checking further.
